$description: InlineEdit (platform/components/InlineEdit), library wave 6, lane C: its component tokens. The read view takes the text field's size, padding and type (the input tokens) so the value does not move when it turns into the field; its states are the system's hover tint and focus border color.

inline-edit-read-background.$description: InlineEdit read view: no fill at rest; the value reads as text.

inline-edit-read-border-color.$description: InlineEdit read view: the border, kept and transparent at rest so the read view has the field's size.

inline-edit-read-border-width.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's border width.

inline-edit-read-radius.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's corners.

inline-edit-read-text.$description: InlineEdit read view: the value's color (the field's text).

inline-edit-read-empty-text.$description: InlineEdit read view: the prompt shown for an empty value (the placeholder's color).

inline-edit-read-font-family.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's font.

inline-edit-read-data-font-family.$description: InlineEdit read view with data: a technical value, in the data font.

inline-edit-read-font-size.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's size.

inline-edit-read-line-height.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's line height.

inline-edit-read-min-height.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's height.

inline-edit-read-padding-inline.$description: InlineEdit read view: the text field's side padding, so the text starts where the field's does.

inline-edit-read-textarea-padding-block.$description: InlineEdit read view of a text area: the text area's padding above and below.

inline-edit-read-gap.$description: InlineEdit read view: the space between the value and the pencil.

inline-edit-read-hover-background.$description: InlineEdit read view: the hover tint, the hint that the value can be edited.

inline-edit-read-focus-border-color.$description: InlineEdit read view: the border in focus (no ring outside it).

inline-edit-hint-text.$description: InlineEdit pencil: its color, on hover and focus.

inline-edit-actions-gap.$description: InlineEdit edit view: the space between the field and its buttons, and between the buttons.

inline-edit-error-text.$description: InlineEdit: the message under an invalid field (the Field error's color).

inline-edit-error-font-size.$description: InlineEdit: the message's size (the Field error's).

inline-edit-error-gap.$description: InlineEdit: the space above the message.
